name: Login AWP
author: AWP Software

sections.description:
Login AWP turns the standard WordPress login screen into a professional, on-brand experience. No coding required — upload a logo, set a background, pick a theme, and fine-tune every detail with the visual Style Builder.

Brand your login in minutes

  • Upload a custom logo or use your site icon automatically
  • Set a full-screen background image with smooth transitions
  • Choose from ready-made login themes
  • Fine-tune colors, fonts, borders, spacing, and more with the live Style Builder
  • Fully responsive and retina-ready design that looks great on every device

Built to be fast and clean

  • Lightweight and optimized for quick page loads
  • No bloat: styles load only where they’re needed
  • Seamless integration under the WordPress “Appearance” menu
  • Translation-ready (includes Spanish)

Who is it for?

Whether you manage a client site, run a brand, or build a community platform, Login AWP lets you deliver a consistent, professional first impression — effortlessly, and without touching a line of code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/login-awp/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Navigate to Appearance → Login AWP to start customizing your login screen.
sections.faq:
Can I change the background image?

Yes. Go to Appearance → Login AWP, then select the “Background” tab to upload your image.

What happens if I don’t set a logo?

Your site icon is used automatically. You can also upload a custom logo from the plugin settings.

My background image is slow to load. What should I do?

Use optimized images under 500KB in JPG or WEBP format for the best performance.

How do I apply a pre-designed theme?

Open the “Themes” tab in the plugin settings, click a theme to preview it, and activate the one you like.

Can I fully customize styles without code?

Yes. Use the “Style Builder” tab to visually change colors, fonts, borders, spacing, and more with a live preview.

How can I provide feedback about this plugin?

After using the plugin for a short period, administrators will see a feedback notification where they can leave a review. You can also share feedback when deactivating the plugin.

The login page isn’t loading my custom styles. What should I do?

Clear your browser cache first. If the issue persists, temporarily disable other plugins that might conflict with login page customization.

I’m getting an error when trying to send feedback while deactivating the plugin. What should I do?

Make sure you’re running the latest version — we’ve fixed the AJAX issue that could occur during feedback submission. If it continues, you can safely skip the feedback step.
